attractions.name: Neriyamangalam Bridge
attractions.description: Often called the 'Gateway to High Ranges,' this historic bridge marks the beginning of Kerala's beautiful hill landscapes. Morning mist often hangs over the river below, creating a calm and photogenic setting.
